name: autonomous-experience-value-v1
hypothesis: A bounded, actually executed autonomous activity during user absence can create persistent state that later causes useful behavior which a strong Memory + Proactive Agent cannot naturally reconstruct at return time.

conclusionRule.note: C requires actual provenance, judge-rated user value >=4, autonomous advantage, failed baseline reconstruction, and stability in at least five scenario IDs. B means behavior differs but C fails. Otherwise A.
